name: marketnow-audit
description: Free security intelligence CLI for the agent economy, powered by LIVE MarketNow endpoints. Audit any domain (scam-check: URL shorteners, suspicious TLDs, typosquatting, punycode, RDAP registry age + TLS server-side), verify any Agent Trust Card (ATC) cryptographically (Ed25519 + RFC 8785 JCS over served bytes, signature + hash + expiry), check OCSP-style revocation status for cards and CA keys (MNR-OCSP-1.0: VALID/EXPIRED/REVOKED/SUPERSEDED/UNKNOWN with PERMIT/DENY recommendation, fail-closed on unknown), and browse the 9,000+ skill catalog with Sentinel scores and risk levels. Proper exit codes for CI/agent pipelines: 0 = PERMIT/verified, 2 = CAUTION/UNKNOWN, 1 = DENY/revoked. Zero dependencies.
author: AliceLabs LLC <info@alicelabs.site>
